newsitem.title: UK: Barnes Trust buys TV studios from Pearson.
newsitem.headline: Barnes Trust buys TV studios from Pearson.

text.p: British media company Barnes Trust Media Ltd has bought Teddington Studios from Pearson Television for 12 million stg, Gresham Trust capital management said on Thursday.
Gresham, which backed the deal with 3.9 million stg equity capital, said the acquisition makes Barnes Trust Media Britain's largest independent media facilities group.

Teddington Studios is used to make programmes for the BBC, ITV, Channel 4 and cable and satellite stations. Under the deal, Pearson Television, a division of the Pearson Plc media group, will continue to use the studios as a supplier, Gresham said in a statement.
